run_simulate_pillars: run simulate_pillars to compute wavelength-dependent reflection of circular silver pillars using FMM
run_permittivity_ag_drude: run permittivity_ag_drude to compute the permittivity of silver for given wavelengths via the Rakic model
run_pillar_density: run pillar_density to generate a 2D density grid for a circular pillar array
run_compute_fields: run compute_fields to compute 3D electric and magnetic fields from simulation intermediate results
summarize_metal_pillars_example: summarize the metal_pillars example which simulates reflection from silver pillar arrays using rigorous coupled-wave analysis
